verdict.rationale: The dos.ny.gov guidance pages (certificate of incorporation, forming a business corporation, Division of Corporations, homepage) were fetched and quoted verbatim, which indicates the HTML reading surface served real content. Probes to the same host returned clean HTTP 404s rather than a bot wall, CAPTCHA, or JS shell. The transport-level block on filings.dos.ny.gov and the robots.txt 'Disallow: /' on Business Express apply to the transactional and portal hosts, not the public guidance pages, though they show agent access to the wider surface is uneven. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming HTTP 200 with a standard identified UA on the guidance pages and no challenge, independent corroboration of agent reachability, and machine-friendly reading aids (llms.txt and .md variants both 404).
